title: Undo the frequencies with a scale
hook: Reversing a transform’s sign does not yet reverse its scale.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Recover time coefficients by reversing Fourier signs and applying the 1/n normalization.

misconception: Running the forward transform a second time always recovers the input unchanged.
objective: Recover time coefficients by reversing Fourier signs and applying the 1/n normalization.

claims.text: Conjugating before and after the forward transform reverses the exponent sign. The composition still multiplies the original coefficients by the transform length, so division by that length is essential. The comparison deliberately omits only that final normalization.
